text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Grey dots: the highest hourly power of each day, in megawatts (MW). Orange line: the estimator's capacity in MW, which should sit near the top of the dots and drop where capacity is lost. Every panel uses one vertical range. Day 1 is the first day shown; no dates are given. Blue shading: the month in which the loss was planted. All rows are exploratory.'
text.tspan: Grey dots: the highest hourly power of each day, in megawatts (MW). Orange line: the estimator's capacity in MW,
which should sit near the top of the dots and drop where capacity is lost.
Every panel uses one vertical range. Day 1 is the first day shown; no dates are given.
Blue shading: the month in which the loss was planted.
